scientific_limitations: Two output classes, strictly positive class-probabilities, finite real signals, and unweighted complete-pair Gini variation only. Sharp total-variation radii are sufficient neighbourhood bounds, not necessary mass-by-mass conditions. The mass-concentration supremum is not attained under strict positivity when both class sizes exceed one. Literature priority is not guaranteed against inaccessible or unindexed exact analogues.
title: Sharp Gini stability polytope for weighted two-cell conditional expectations
